experimental_constraint: Relations are optional, not required for structural completeness. Create a relation only when the original text independently expresses a relation between the two elements with compatible direction and semantic strength.

structures.name: 日记的自我监控功能
structures.subject: 日记作为监控工具实现自我掌控的功能

elements.name: 监控工具
elements.description: 日记被用作系统性记录成功与过失的监控工具

evidence.quote: Anne-Marie Millim in 2013 describes the 19th-century diary as a 'monitoring tool' in which the ultimate goal was self-mastery

elements.name: 跨时间自我比较
elements.description: 通过记录，日记作者可以比较过去、现在和未来自我的成就

evidence.quote: By carefully recording their successes and lapses, diary-writers could compare the achievements of their past, current and future selves

elements.name: 竞争性同辈衡量
elements.description: 将自己与兄弟、同学等同辈进行比较

evidence.quote: He often compared himself with his elder brother Thomas, two years his senior, as well as his classmates

elements.name: 持续失败感
elements.description: 追求自我掌控的压力可能导致持续的失败感

evidence.quote: The pressure to achieve self-mastery and constantly improve could create a sense of continual failure

structures.name: 印刷日记作为组织工具
structures.subject: 印刷日记从反思工具向规划工具的转变

elements.name: 功能转变
elements.description: 从单纯记录过去经历转变为规划未来的组织工具

evidence.quote: the great Victorian innovation in diary-keeping was the switch from the use of the diary solely as a means of reflecting on past actions to the use of pre-printed diaries to plan the future

elements.name: 商业化产品
elements.description: 印刷日记成为流行的文具产品，针对特定社会群体销售

evidence.quote: by 1862 Letts offered 55 different versions targeted at specific social groups

elements.name: 多功能整合
elements.description: 整合年鉴、日历和日记功能，包含火车时刻表等实用信息

evidence.quote: the new printed diary drew on the tradition of the long-established family almanac, combining the functions of almanac, calendar and diary in one multifunctional book

elements.name: 时间控制承诺
elements.description: 印刷日记承诺对时间、地点和自我的完全控制

evidence.quote: A printed diary held out the promise of total control over time, place and the self

structures.name: 日记的公私阈限实践
structures.subject: 日记作为公共与私人领域之间的阈限文本

elements.name: 公私阈限
elements.description: 日记处于公共与私人领域的阈限位置

evidence.quote: diaries were texts on the threshold of public and private

elements.name: 共享阅读
elements.description: 在婚姻内共享阅读日记是常见习惯

evidence.quote: Shared reading of diaries was a common habit within marriages

elements.name: 密码系统
elements.description: 使用密码记录敏感信息，调控对最私密部分的访问

evidence.quote: the use of secret code by some diarists to record particularly sensitive information in itself anticipates an audience for the un-coded content

elements.name: 教化遗产
elements.description: 日记被视为教化遗产，家族历史链条中的一环

evidence.quote: the diary was seen as a didactic legacy, one of the links in a family history's chain

structures.name: 时间意识强化
structures.subject: 维多利亚时期对时间流逝意识的强化

elements.name: 时间意识增强
elements.description: 维多利亚时期人们对时间流逝的意识比以往任何时候都强

evidence.quote: In the Victorian period, people were more aware of the passing of time than ever before

elements.name: 精确时间安排
elements.description: 手表和时钟使中产阶级能够精确安排日常

evidence.quote: Wrist watches and clocks allowed the middle classes to schedule their days with precision

elements.name: 标准化时间
elements.description: 1880年《时间定义法案》确立格林威治标准时间

evidence.quote: In 1880, the Definition of Time Act proclaimed a standardised national time: Greenwich Mean Time

elements.name: 时间焦虑
elements.description: 对时间有限性的焦虑，需要明智地使用时间

evidence.quote: Such anxieties prompted an intensified awareness of the finiteness of time and the need to use one's time wisely

conceptualization.description: 文章围绕'维多利亚时期日记作为自我监控工具'这一核心概念组织，相关概念包括组织功能、公私实践和时间意识，但未形成形式化的概念层级或本体

rejected_candidates.description: 维多利亚自我优化系统
rejected_candidates.reason: 文章未明确将所有元素表述为单一集成系统

evidence.quote: Nineteenth-century diaries show a growing middle class engaged in a constant quest for self-mastery and productivity

rejected_candidates.description: 日记类型演化（宗教→世俗）
rejected_candidates.reason: 文章描述的是层叠/影响，而非清洁的演化阶段

evidence.quote: Within the diary, Enlightenment ideals of scientific empiricism could be harnessed in support of the evangelically inspired project of self-improvement

rejected_candidates.reason: 文章提到不同阶级但未明确按阶级分类日记实践

evidence.quote: the majority of diaries were written either by people conscious of their own importance... or by fervent Puritans

rejected_candidates.reason: 文章提到Nunns的competitive mindset但未明确将其框架为更广泛的文化结构

evidence.quote: a competitive mindset that matched the spirit of the age

rejected_candidates.description: 自我量化谱系（维多利亚→现代）
rejected_candidates.reason: 这是作者的比较框架装置，而非维多利亚时期本身的结构

evidence.quote: this culture of self-quantification in the pursuit of self-improvement long predates social media
